title: Research note: packing ceiling (+0.87%) and 1/99 budget for the selected complex local word (no new kappa)
body:
**Scope:** a scoped obstruction plus a screening tool. No new κ, and the selected record is unchanged.

## Task card
- **Card:** `complex-new-helper-inventory` (complex-mechanisms track, chooser seed `f10085bdeb241ba1cd1390dfec98a448`, base `e3bb23b4`). Scope is **refined** to the card's first experiment: an optimistic exact relaxation that rejects routes without headroom. It is applied to packing of the incumbent word and turned into a calculator for proposed inventories.
- **Question:** with the selected #1094 local word fixed, how much can any hosting, owner or idle-remainder repacking gain? What would a changed helper inventory have to pay to reach a = 1/99?

## Result
- The selected local word pays `{1:2412, 2:418, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8}` per call (mass 5,586). Live stock is 896 data families per nine-stage replica, with all helpers hosted.
- PR1012's coverage identity (`mass = 72W + 64N`, re-checked on the selected profile) fixes the idle mass at 1,646 per call. Cost per unit mass `r^(-a)·73^(a-1)` does not increase with r, so the best idle histogram puts all idle mass at the halving-guard maximum rank, 51, with fractional counts allowed.
- **Packing ceiling:** a < **0.001690054109089**, so κ < **0.0016872026** (**+0.869%**). This is certified with exact rational intervals.
- **Previous record #1042:** it splits as the same local word plus an admissible idle histogram. The derived idle histogram `{1:2249, 2:1, 3:400, 7:3, 16:47, 48:4850}` matches its README exactly, and its endpoint lies below the same ceiling. So all of #1042→#1094 was packing, and less than 0.87% of that headroom remains.
- **Planning target a = 1/99:** written as `Σ n_r p_r(a) ≤ B(a)`, the word's excess spend is **20.4 times** the per-call budget (2.597 against 0.1275). Deleting all rank-1 children cannot reach it. A target-scale gain needs about 95% lower fully priced local excess spend, or a changed coverage law: unpaid coordinates per family, the 64-per-call centre charge, or families per call.
- **Tool:** `ceiling.ceiling(local, 73, 896, 9, 64)` screens any proposed per-call local profile in about a second.

## Not covered
- This is one local word, port count, template, coverage law and outer recipe.
- Open claims that change the word (#1148's joint-entrance word and its descendants, all ≤ 0.0016759) are **not** bounded by it. Their ceilings are an open question in the README.
- Fractional counts and every repacking are allowed, and realizability is not checked.
- `κ < a/(1+a)` is the retained planning ceiling.

## Controls
- An idle-rank cap of 52 is rejected by the halving guard.
- A local mass beyond the coverage law is rejected.
- One extra rank-1 child lowers the ceiling.
- 25 sampled integer idle histograms all have exact moment > 1 at the ceiling.

## Reproduce
```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-local-word-ceiling/verify.py   # ~10 s
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-local-word-ceiling
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
```

**Credit:** the coverage identity is PR1012's. The fixed-word packing-ceiling lineage is static44, PR525 and PR643; the catalogue mixture bound is Ali Romman's heterogeneous-owner-assembly.
